_README: A ROLE PROFILE is the only place role-specific knowledge lives. Every script in scripts/ reads it and hardcodes nothing. Fill this in AFTER the scorecard exists — the keywords should fall out of the A-bar legs, not the other way round. Keys starting with _ are documentation and are ignored.
context: <one or two sentences: stage, team size, what is breaking, what this hire must fix>
_min_score: Keyword-score floor for a post to be worth a human look. Raise it if the sweep is noisy, lower it for short-form sources. It is a triage threshold, NOT the A-bar.

keywords._: REQUIRED. 'must' terms are the ones that only a plausible candidate would write about themselves. 'stack' terms are supporting technology. 'location' terms are geography and work-authorization phrases. Non-ASCII terms are matched as substrings, ASCII terms on word boundaries.
must: <signal that only a real candidate would claim>

sources._: Per-lane switches. Omit a lane to accept its defaults; set enabled:false to skip it.

curated_repos: <owner/repo the right person would have contributed to>
github._curated_repos: The highest-signal lane in the whole sweep. 15-25 repos chosen by someone who knows the domain beats any keyword search.

abar_legs: L1 <non-negotiable leg, stated so that PASS/FAIL is decidable from a profile>
L5 <at least N distinct public evidence URLs, all resolving>
_abar_legs: Copy these verbatim from the scorecard. They are the filter AND the judge's rubric. Every one must be decidable from evidence a stranger can open.
exclude: <adjacent-but-not profile that will flood the results>
<category that is not recruitable, e.g. founders currently fundraising>
